messages:
Aisha Rahman: Hi all, Aisha here 1st day on Platform Tools. Need staging Console access + feature-flag admin on staging. Prod should be view-only. Who's the right approver?
Tom G: hey Aisha, welcome! I'm your manager. Approve from my side. @Jules can you kick off the access flow?
Jules (devex): welcome! Quick notes: 1) use https://internal.redwood/accessr to request `console:staging-flag-admin` and `console:prod-flag-reader`. 2) attach ticket ONB-612 and set Tom as approver. 3) security needs 2FA + training ack.
Aisha Rahman: done request ONB-612, shows pending. I attached manager note.
access-bot: Access request ONB-612 created for user aisha.rahman (roles: console:staging-flag-admin, console:prod-flag-reader). Status: pending.
Tom G: approved ONB-612.
Marta (sec): looping in security 1 quick check: SSO ok? 2FA enrolled? training?
Aisha Rahman: SSO ok. Enrolled Authenticator app. Training ack done.
access-bot: Security checks passed (2FA: enrolled, training: acknowledged).
Marta (sec): Approved prod read-only. Note: prod read-only cannot see unreleased experimental flags. If you need to preview drafts, ask for staging admin only (good).
Jules (devex): Role granted for staging. Youll be added to team `console-staging-admins`. Expect group email.
Aisha Rahman: I can see staging flags and toggle in `staging/canary`. Prod is read-only as requested. Thanks!
Aisha Rahman: One more Q: when I toggle a flag in staging and the publish job fails with a 500, who's first contact?
Tom G: ping #eng-oncall and include the `publish-id` and UI trace. Tag me too if you suspect a runtime issue.
Jules (devex): Also check the rollout runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/flags/rollout (section "troubleshooting publish failures"). It has the exact logs to grab.
Aisha Rahman: super helpful, closing thread. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
